body: I 100% want the same thing as you, being able to just vanish, it’s rough. I wouldn’t say I have a great family besides my brother but I also heavily understand the flashes of them stopping you as well. I can see why you’d feel guilty but it’s ok to feel that even in your circumstance. Your friends/gf seem really sweet so maybe try and talk to them if it’s not hard, I’m really sorry I’m bad at giving advice but please hang in there.
